posts: Anatomy of an intents swap: user signs one intent, solvers compete to fill it from their own inventory, output lands on the destination chain. No bridge hops, no approval maze — the quote you accept is the whole trade. #intents #chainabstraction

replies.text: Half agree — cycles set the ceiling. But intents shift the floor: solvers fill from inventory, so cross-chain swaps keep clearing even when bridge volume dries up. Routing default beats roadmap.
Solver-side view: intent flow quotes against deep stable pairs like yours, so that 14% APR is a volume story. The chop you ate is the cost of being the liquidity solvers route through.
